scope: HBase 2.6.6 original 30 selected Mallory candidate workloads
basis: Source inference and separately labeled terminal JVM healthy-seed receipts; no eligibility or fault-result update

cases.reason: The test creates an enabled table and explicitly calls relocateRegion; a normal meta lookup can evaluate the dead-server check without throwing.
cases.next_step: Run a healthy target/site-catalog calibration and inspect the selected exception before any bug classification.

cases.reason: Cleanup may disable an old table, but the test creates a fresh enabled table before relocateRegion; the disabled-table precondition should evaluate false.

cases.reason: testMobStoreScanner delegates to several scanner helpers that call admin.flush on the created table; the enabled-table check can take its normal branch.

cases.reason: Both snapshot restores are preceded by disableTable; the restoreSnapshot disabled-table check can evaluate false.

cases.reason: The test creates and reads a named namespace before table operations; getNamespace can return its descriptor. Its quota-failure stages concern other checks.

cases.reason: The test unassigns a region and then tries a move, but it catches DoNotRetryRegionException rather than this check's HBaseIOException for a live procedure. Whether preTransitCheck sees a procedure still attached needs a healthy trace.
cases.next_step: Run a healthy target/site-catalog calibration and inspect the selected exception before any bug classification.

cases.reason: After explicitly unassigning a region, the test moves it and catches the selected DoNotRetryRegionException as the intended result.

cases.reason: The test disables the table, attempts a move, and catches the selected DoNotRetryIOException as the intended result.

cases.reason: The test kills a region server and waits for three procedure timeout increases. The selected throw is documented in confirmClosed as a normal signal to retry with backoff when the region remains CLOSING; target throws must not automatically count as bugs.
cases.next_step: Run a healthy target/site-catalog calibration and inspect the selected exception before any bug classification.

cases.reason: The selected check is a Java assert in confirmClosed. A direct-Java test JVM must enable assertions with -ea; the test's server-abort sequence may then reach this assertion, subject to runtime trace.
cases.next_step: Run a healthy target/site-catalog calibration and inspect the selected exception before any bug classification.

cases.reason: The test injects an assignment failure and waits for the procedure. confirmOpened throws the selected HBaseIOException after too many immediate retries to back off; if observed, it may be expected internal recovery behavior.
cases.next_step: Run a healthy target/site-catalog calibration and inspect the selected exception before any bug classification.
